SM Job Fair goes beyond jobs with FREE AI upskilling
description: As artificial intelligence changes how people learn, work, and do business, SM Supermalls is helping bring the skills needed to navigate that change closer to Filipino communities. On September 12, SM Center Sangandaan became a community learning hub as SM Supermalls, Asia Pacific College (APC), and IBM SkillsBuild brought free AI upskilling to 109 participants, including teachers, students, working professionals, and government employees. The initiative forms part of SM Job Fair’s broader approach to workforce development—connecting Filipinos not only with employment opportunities, but also with the skills and services that can help them prepare for what comes next. LEARNING STARTS HERE. Participants register for the free AI upskilling session at SM Center Sangandaan, bringing future-ready learning closer to the community. MAKING AI PRACTICAL FOR EVERYDAY FILIPINOS As technology evolves, even digitally inclined learners need opportunities to update what they know, test their understanding, and build skills relevant to an increasingly AI-enabled workplace. Led by trainers from Asia Pacific College, participants explored how AI can support research, productivity, day-to-day tasks, and professional development, while gaining a better understanding of how to use the technology effectively and responsibly. For Daniel Aplan, a BS Information Technology student at the University of Caloocan City, the session helped strengthen—and even challenge—what he already knew about AI. “This is an opportunity to acquire skills in AI, eto po ang pinaka-useful thing sa ngayon. May mga concept po na alam ko noon na mas naayos at mayroon ding nabago because of this training. For educators, learning AI carries another urgency: understanding the same technology their students are already encountering. Maolen Torres, a secondary school teacher at Maypajo High School, admitted that she initially had apprehensions about using AI—but recognized that learning it was necessary to keep pace with her students. “May mga fear ako sa paggamit ng AI, pero sabi ko, kailangan ko ’to para makasabay ako sa mga estudyante ko. Basic lang pala siya, pero yung basic na ’yon kailangan ko talaga para makatulong sa’kin sa pagtuturo.” For Maryann Dela Vega-Pono, a teacher at Isabelo Delos Reyes Elementary School, opportunities to learn new technologies should be made available to more people. “I encourage everyone na umattend sa mga ganitong seminar kasi marami kayong matutunan. Ang benefits nito ay mapupunta sa inyo. Malaking bagay po ito para sa atin, hindi lang sa teachers, para sa lahat.” Through practical exposure, participants experienced AI in simple, less intimidating applications where responsible use remained the center of learning–emphasizing the importance of verifying information, recognizing the limitations of AI-generated content, and protecting personal data. For the trainers, seeing participants discover what AI can actually do is also part of the reward. Gonzalo Gumogda, Professor of Cybersecurity at Asia Pacific College, said the reactions of learners demonstrate how practical AI education can be for different audiences. “Natutuwa po akong nakikita ang mga reaction ng mga tinuturuan ko na may shocked reactions after discovering more about AI. Very practical po kasi siya para sa lahat.” For Gumogda, the opportunity to share this knowledge also carries the potential for greater reach. “For now, dito lang sa Manila, hopefully soon, sa buong bansa na. Maraming benefits po ang AI, every company is using it now.” Asia Pacific College trainer Gonzalo Gumogda breaks down AI into practical knowledge learners can apply to school, work, and everyday life. LEARNING THAT CONTINUES BEYOND THE SESSION The learning journey does not have to end when participants leave the mall. Through IBM SkillsBuild, participants can continue developing digital and professional capabilities beyond the face-to-face session. The collaboration combines APC’s academic expertise, IBM SkillsBuild’s digital learning resources, and SM’s community reach to make relevant knowledge more accessible as technologies and workplace requirements evolve. CURIOSITY INTO CONFIDENCE. Learners engage directly with trainers, asking questions and gaining a better understanding of how AI can work for them. FROM MALLS TO COMMUNITY HUBS Bringing free upskilling into malls addresses one of the most fundamental barriers to learning: access. By turning familiar and accessible destinations such as SM Center Sangandaan into learning spaces, training can reach students, educators, jobseekers, professionals, and other community members closer to where they live. It is also part of a larger evolution of SM’s employment advocacy. SM Job Fairs connect Filipinos directly with employers. Free upskilling sessions help build relevant capabilities. And in select malls, SM Government Service Express (GSE) brings essential government services closer to communities. Together, these platforms support different stages of the career journey—from learning new skills and finding employment to accessing government services conveniently within the community. Since SM began rolling out free upskilling sessions in May 2026, the initiative has covered areas such as AI literacy, cybersecurity, digital productivity, and basic graphic design, helping more Filipinos develop capabilities for a changing workplace. Cedrik Forbes, Lead of SM Job Fairs at SM Supermalls, shares how upskilling complements employment opportunities by helping Filipinos build future-ready skills for the evolving world of work. LEARNING BY DOING. Participants put new knowledge into practice as trainers guide them through interactive AI activities using their own devices. MORE FREE LEARNING AHEAD More free upskilling sessions are scheduled across SM malls this September: September 19 – SM City North EDSA September 19 – SM Center San Pedro September 20 - SM City Urdaneta Central September 26 – SM City North EDSA September 26 – SM City Tuguegarao September 26 – SM Center San Pedro September 29 - SM City Manila SM Job Fairs continue to bring employers and career opportunities closer to communities: September 16 - SM City North EDSA September 16 - 17 SM Seaside City Cebu September 22 - 23 - SM Seaside City Cebu September 23 - SM City Calamba September 23 - SM Center Las Piñas September 24 - SM Center Pulilan September 24 - SM City Bacoor *Schedules may be subject to change. FUTURE-READY, TOGETHER. A diverse community of learners gathers at SM Center Sangandaan, showing how accessible upskilling can help more Filipinos prepare for the changing world of work.
